verses.en: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.pt: No princípio era a Palavra, e a Palavra estava junto de Deus, e a Palavra era Deus.
verses.en_web: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.en_bbe: From the first he was the Word, and the Word was in relation with God and was God.

verses.en: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.pt: Esta estava no princípio junto de Deus.
verses.en_web: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.en_bbe: This Word was from the first in relation with God.

verses.en: All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made.
verses.pt: Por esta foram feitas todas as coisas, e sem ela não se fez coisa nenhuma do que foi feito.
verses.en_web: All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.
verses.en_bbe: All things came into existence through him, and without him nothing was.

verses.en: In him was life; and the life was the light of men.
verses.pt: Nela estava a vida, e a vida era a luz dos seres humanos.
verses.en_web: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
verses.en_bbe: What came into existence in him was life, and the life was the light of men.

verses.en: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
verses.pt: E a luz brilha nas trevas; e as trevas não a compreenderam.
verses.en_web: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
verses.en_bbe: And the light goes on shining in the dark; it is not overcome by the dark.

verses.en: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.pt: Houve um homem enviado por Deus, cujo nome era João.
verses.en_web: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.en_bbe: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.

verses.en: The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe.
verses.pt: Este veio por testemunho, para que testemunhasse da Luz, para que todos por ele cressem.
verses.en_web: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.en_bbe: He came for witness, to give witness about the light, so that all men might have faith through him.

verses.en: He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.
verses.pt: Ele não era a Luz; mas foi enviado para que testemunhasse da Luz.
verses.en_web: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
verses.en_bbe: He himself was not the light: he was sent to give witness about the light.

verses.en: That was the true Light, which lighteth every man that cometh into the world.
verses.pt: Esta era a luz verdadeira, que ilumina a todo ser humano que vem ao mundo.
verses.en_web: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
verses.en_bbe: The true light, which gives light to every man, was then coming into the world.

verses.en: He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.
verses.pt: No mundo estava, e por ele foi feito o mundo; e o mundo não o conheceu.
verses.en_web: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
verses.en_bbe: He was in the world, the world which came into being through him, but the world had no knowledge of him.

verses.en: He came unto his own, and his own received him not.
verses.pt: Ao seu próprio veio, e os seus não o receberam.
verses.en_web: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
verses.en_bbe: He came to the things which were his and his people did not take him to their hearts.

verses.en: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:
verses.pt: Mas a todos quantos o receberam, deu-lhes poder de serem feitos filhos de Deus: aos que creem em seu nome.
verses.en_web: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
verses.en_bbe: To all those who did so take him, however, he gave the right of becoming children of God--that is, to those who had faith in his name:

verses.en: Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.pt: Os quais não são gerados de sangue, nem de vontade da carne, nem de vontade de homem, mas sim de Deus.
verses.en_web: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.en_bbe: Whose birth was from God and not from blood, or from an impulse of the flesh and man's desire.

verses.en: And the Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth.
verses.pt: E aquela Palavra se fez carne, e habitou entre nós; (e vimos sua glória, como glória do unigênito do Pai) cheio de graça e de verdade.
verses.en_web: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.en_bbe: And so the Word became flesh and took a place among us for a time; and we saw his glory--such glory as is given to an only son by his father--saw it to be true and full of grace.

verses.en: John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spake, He that cometh after me is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.pt: E João dele testemunhou, e clamou, dizendo: Este era aquele, de quem eu dizia: O que vem após mim é antes de mim; porque era primeiro que eu.
verses.en_web: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
verses.en_bbe: John gave witness about him, crying, This is he of whom I said, He who is coming after me is put over me because he was in existence before me.

verses.en: And of his fulness have all we received, and grace for grace.
verses.pt: E de sua plenitude recebemos todos também graça por graça.
verses.en_web: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
verses.en_bbe: From his full measure we have all been given grace on grace.

verses.en: For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: Porque a Lei foi dada por Moisés; a graça e a verdade foi feita por Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: For the law was given through Moses; grace and the true way of life are ours through Jesus Christ.

verses.en: No man hath seen God at any time; the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he hath declared him.
verses.pt: A Deus nunca ninguém o viu; o unigênito Filho, que está no seio do Pai, ele o declarou.
verses.en_web: No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.
verses.en_bbe: No man has seen God at any time; the only Son, who is on the breast of the Father, he has made clear what God is.

verses.en: And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who art thou?
verses.pt: E este é o testemunho de João, quando os judeus mandaram alguns sacerdotes e levitas de Jerusalém, que lhe perguntassem: Tu quem és?
verses.en_web: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
verses.en_bbe: And this is the witness of John when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to him with the question, Who are you?

verses.en: And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ.
verses.pt: E confessou, e não negou; e confessou: Eu não sou o Cristo.
verses.en_web: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
verses.en_bbe: He said quite openly and straightforwardly, I am not the Christ.

verses.en: And they asked him, What then? Art thou Elias? And he saith, I am not. Art thou that prophet? And he answered, No.
verses.pt: E lhe perguntaram: Que, então? És tu Elias? E ele disse: Não sou. Eles disseram: Tu és o Profeta? E ele respondeu: Não.
verses.en_web: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said to him, What then? Are you Elijah? And he said, I am not. Are you the prophet? And his answer was, I am not.

verses.en: Then said they unto him, Who art thou? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What sayest thou of thyself?
verses.pt: Disseram-lhe pois: Quem és? Para darmos resposta aos que nos enviaram. Que dizes de ti mesmo?
verses.en_web: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
verses.en_bbe: So they said to him, Who are you then? We have to give some answer to those who sent us. What have you to say about yourself?

verses.en: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Esaias.
verses.pt: Disse: Eu sou a voz do que clama no deserto: Endireitai o caminho do Senhor, como disse o profeta Isaías.
verses.en_web: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
verses.en_bbe: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the waste land, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.

verses.en: And they which were sent were of the Pharisees.
verses.pt: E os enviados eram dos fariseus.
verses.en_web: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
verses.en_bbe: Those who had been sent came from the Pharisees.

verses.en: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?
verses.pt: E perguntaram-lhe, e disseram-lhe: Por que pois batizas, se tu não és o Cristo, nem Elias, nem o profeta?
verses.en_web: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
verses.en_bbe: And they put this question to him, saying, Why then are you giving baptism if you are not the Christ, or Elijah, or the prophet?

verses.en: John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there standeth one among you, whom ye know not;
verses.pt: João lhes respondeu, dizendo: Eu batizo com água; mas em meio de vós, está a quem vós não conheceis,
verses.en_web: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
verses.en_bbe: John's answer was: I give baptism with water; but there is one among you of whom you have no knowledge;

verses.en: He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe’s latchet I am not worthy to unloose.
verses.pt: Este é aquele que vem após mim, o qual já foi antes de mim, do qual eu não sou digno de desatar a tira de sua sandália.
verses.en_web: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
verses.en_bbe: It is he who is coming after me; I am not good enough to undo his shoes.

verses.en: These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.pt: Estas coisas aconteceram em Betábara, do outro lado do Jordão, onde João estava batizando.
verses.en_web: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.en_bbe: These things took place at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was giving baptism.

verses.en: The next day John seeth Jesus coming unto him, and saith, Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.
verses.pt: O dia seguinte viu João a Jesus vir a ele, e disse: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus, que tira o pecado do mundo.
verses.en_web: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.en_bbe: The day after, John sees Jesus coming to him and says, See, here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!

verses.en: This is he of whom I said, After me cometh a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me.
verses.pt: Este é aquele do qual eu disse: Após mim vem um homem que já foi antes de mim; porque já era primeiro que eu.
verses.en_web: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
verses.en_bbe: This is he of whom I said, One is coming after me who is put over me because he was in existence before me.

verses.en: And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water.
verses.pt: E eu não o conhecia; mas para que fosse manifesto a Israel, por isso vim eu batizando com água.
verses.en_web: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: I myself had no knowledge of him, but I came giving baptism with water so that he might be seen openly by Israel.

verses.en: And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him.
verses.pt: E João testemunhou, dizendo: Eu vi o Espírito como pomba descer do céu, e repousou sobre ele.
verses.en_web: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
verses.en_bbe: And John gave this witness, saying, I saw the Spirit coming down from heaven like a dove and resting on him.

verses.en: And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom thou shalt see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizeth with the Holy Ghost.
verses.pt: E eu não o conhecia, mas aquele que me mandou a batizar com água, esse me disse: Sobre aquele que vires descer ao Espírito, e repousar sobre ele, esse é o que batiza com Espírito Santo.
verses.en_web: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
verses.en_bbe: I had no knowledge who he was, but he who sent me to give baptism with water said to me, The one on whom you see the Spirit coming down and resting, it is he who gives baptism with the Holy Spirit.

verses.en: And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God.
verses.pt: E eu o vi, e testemunhado tenho, que este é o Filho de Deus.
verses.en_web: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
verses.en_bbe: This I saw myself and my witness is that he is the Son of God.

verses.en: Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples;
verses.pt: O seguinte dia estava outra vez ali João, e dois de seus discípulos.
verses.en_web: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
verses.en_bbe: The day after, John was there again with two of his disciples;

verses.en: And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he saith, Behold the Lamb of God!
verses.pt: E vendo por ali andar a Jesus, disse: Eis o Cordeiro de Deus.
verses.en_web: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
verses.en_bbe: And looking at Jesus while he was walking he said, See, there is the Lamb of God!

verses.en: And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.pt: E os dois discípulos ouviram -lhe dizer aquilo, e seguiram a Jesus.
verses.en_web: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Hearing what he said, the two disciples went after Jesus.

verses.en: Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and saith unto them, What seek ye? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwellest thou?
verses.pt: E Jesus, virando-se, e vendo-os seguir, disse-lhes: Que buscais? E eles lhe disseram: Rabi, (que traduzido, quer dizer, Mestre) onde moras?
verses.en_web: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus, turning round, saw them coming after him and said to them, What are you looking for? They said to him, Rabbi (which is to say, Master), where are you living?

verses.en: He saith unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes ele: Vinde, e vede-o; Vieram, e viram onde morava, e na companhia dele naquele dia; e já era quase a hora décima.
verses.en_web: He said to them, “Come, and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
verses.en_bbe: He said to them, Come and see. They went with him then and saw where he was living; and they were with him all that day: it was then about the tenth hour of the day.

verses.en: One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.pt: Era André, o irmão de Simão Pedro, um dos dois que ouvira aquilo de João, e o haviam seguido.
verses.en_web: One of the two who heard John, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.en_bbe: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two men who, hearing what John said, went after Jesus.

verses.en: He first findeth his own brother Simon, and saith unto him, We have found the Messias, which is, being interpreted, the Christ.
verses.pt: Este achou primeiro a seu irmão Simão, e disse-lhe: Já achamos ao Messias(que traduzido, é o Cristo).
verses.en_web: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
verses.en_bbe: Early in the morning he came across his brother and said to him, We have made discovery! It is the Messiah! (which is to say, the Christ).

verses.en: And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, Thou art Simon the son of Jona: thou shalt be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone.
verses.pt: E levou-o a Jesus. E Jesus, olhando para ele, disse: Tu és Simão, filho de Jonas; tu serás chamado Cefas. (que se traduz Pedro).
verses.en_web: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
verses.en_bbe: And he took him to Jesus. Looking at him fixedly Jesus said, You are Simon, the son of John; your name will be Cephas (which is to say, Peter).

verses.en: The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and findeth Philip, and saith unto him, Follow me.
verses.pt: O dia seguinte Jesus quis ir à Galileia, achou Filipe, e disse-lhe: Segue-me.
verses.en_web: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.en_bbe: The day after this, Jesus had a desire to go into Galilee. He came across Philip and said to him, Come and be my disciple.

verses.en: Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.pt: E Filipe era de Betsaida, da cidade de André e de Pedro.
verses.en_web: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.en_bbe: Now Philip's town was Beth-saida, where Andrew and Peter came from.

verses.en: Philip findeth Nathanael, and saith unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
verses.pt: Filipe achou Natanael, e disse-lhe: Achamos aquele de quem Moisés escreveu na Lei, e os Profetas: a Jesus, o filho de José, de Nazaré.
verses.en_web: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
verses.en_bbe: Philip came across Nathanael and said to him, We have made a discovery! It is he of whom Moses, in the law, and the prophets were writing, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

verses.en: And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip saith unto him, Come and see.
verses.pt: E disse-lhe Natanael: Pode haver alguma coisa boa de Nazaré? Filipe lhe disse: Vem, e vê.
verses.en_web: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
verses.en_bbe: Nazareth! said Nathanael, Is it possible for any good to come out of Nazareth? Philip said to him, Come and see.

verses.en: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and saith of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!
verses.pt: Jesus viu Natanael vir, e disse dele: Eis verdadeiramente um israelita, em quem não há engano!
verses.en_web: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
verses.en_bbe: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and said of him, See, here is a true son of Israel in whom there is nothing false.

verses.en: Nathanael saith unto him, Whence knowest thou me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called thee, when thou wast under the fig tree, I saw thee.
verses.pt: Natanael lhe disse: De onde tu me conheces? Respondeu Jesus, e disse-lhe: Antes que Filipe te chamasse, estando tu debaixo da figueira, eu te vi.
verses.en_web: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
verses.en_bbe: Nathanael said to him, Where did you get knowledge of me? In answer Jesus said, Before Philip was talking with you, while you were still under the fig-tree, I saw you.

verses.en: Nathanael answered and saith unto him, Rabbi, thou art the Son of God; thou art the King of Israel.
verses.pt: Natanael respondeu, e disse-lhe: Rabi, tu és o Filho de Deus, tu és o Rei de Israel!
verses.en_web: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
verses.en_bbe: Nathanael said to him, Rabbi, you are the Son of God, you are King of Israel!

verses.en: Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto thee, I saw thee under the fig tree, believest thou? thou shalt see greater things than these.
verses.pt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Porque te disse: Debaixo da figueira te vi, crês? Tu verás coisas maiores que estas.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
verses.en_bbe: In answer Jesus said to him, You have faith because I said to you, I saw you under the fig-tree. You will see greater things than these.

verses.en: And he saith unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter ye shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.
verses.pt: E disse-lhe: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo, que daqui em diante vereis o céu aberto, e aos anjos de Deus subir e descer sobre o Filho do homem.
verses.en_web: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
verses.en_bbe: And he said to him, Truly I say to you all, You will see heaven opening and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of man.
